INSERT INTO CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS ( RECORD_TARGET_ID, DRAFT_KEY, TARGET_STATUS, SCOPE_TYPE, OWNER_USER_ID, WS_ID, PROJ_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT ) VALUES ( #{recordTargetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{draftKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DRAFT', #{scopeType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ownerUserId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE, #{createdBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE + 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS SET UPDATED_BY = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, EXPIRES_AT = SYSDATE + 1 WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID = #{recordTargetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND TARGET_STATUS = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS SET TARGET_STATUS = 'ABANDONED', UPDATED_BY = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, EXPIRES_AT = SYSDATE + (1 / 24) WHERE DRAFT_KEY = #{draftKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CREATED_BY = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND TARGET_STATUS = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS SET TARGET_STATUS = 'ACTIVE', TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TARGET_ID = #{targetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_BY = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, EXPIRES_AT = NULL WHERE DRAFT_KEY = #{draftKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CREATED_BY = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND TARGET_STATUS = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN NVL(UPPER(p.PROJ_SCOPE), CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NULL THEN 'PERSONAL' ELSE 'GROUP' END) = 'PERSONAL' THEN 'PERSONAL_PROJECT' ELSE 'GROUP_PROJECT' END AS SCOPE_TYPE, CASE WHEN NVL(UPPER(p.PROJ_SCOPE), CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NULL THEN 'PERSONAL' ELSE 'GROUP' END) = 'PERSONAL' THEN p.LEADER_ID ELSE NULL END AS OWNER_USER_ID, CASE WHEN NVL(UPPER(p.PROJ_SCOPE), CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NULL THEN 'PERSONAL' ELSE 'GROUP' END) = 'GROUP' THEN p.WS_ID ELSE NULL END AS WS_ID, p.PROJ_ID, p.LEADER_ID FROM PROJECTS p WHERE p.PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND NVL(p.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') <> 'DELETED'

mapper.select: SELECT RECORD_TARGET_ID FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS WHERE PHOTO_ALBUM_ID = #{photoAlbumId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND TARGET_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT crt.RECORD_TARGET_ID FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS crt JOIN PHOTO_POSTS pp ON pp.ALBUM_ID = crt.PHOTO_ALBUM_ID WHERE pp.POST_ID = #{postId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND crt.TARGET_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS SET PHOTO_ALBUM_ID = #{photoAlbumId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_BY = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID = #{recordTargetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND PHOTO_ALBUM_ID IS NULL

UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS SET FILE_FOLDER_ID = #{fileFolderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_BY = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID = #{recordTargetId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS WHERE TARGET_STATUS = 'ABANDONED' AND EXPIRES_AT < SYSDATE
mapper.select: SELECT CASE t.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'EVENT' THEN NVL((SELECT e.TITLE FROM EVENTS e WHERE e.EVENT_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'PERIOD_PLAN' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_PERIOD_PLANS p WHERE p.PERIOD_PLAN_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'TIME_PLAN' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_TIME_PLANS p WHERE p.TIME_PLAN_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'WEEKLY_PLAN' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_WEEKLY_PLANS p WHERE p.WEEKLY_PLAN_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'TASK' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_TASKS p WHERE p.TASK_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') ELSE '임시 기록' END FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS t WHERE t.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId}

SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM ( SELECT f.FOLDER_ID FROM NOTE_FOLDERS f JOIN CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS t ON t.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} WHERE f.PARENT_FOLDER_ID IS NULL AND f.SCOPE_TYPE=CASE WHEN t.SCOPE_TYPE='PERSONAL' THEN 'PRIVATE' WHEN t.SCOPE_TYPE='GROUP' THEN 'WS' ELSE 'PROJ' END AND NVL(f.WS_ID,-1)=NVL(t.WS_ID,-1) AND NVL(f.PROJ_ID,-1)=NVL(t.PROJ_ID,-1) AND (t.SCOPE_TYPE<>'PERSONAL' OR f.OWNER_USER_ID=NVL(t.OWNER_USER_ID,t.CREATED_BY)) AND f.FOLDER_NAME=CASE t.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'EVENT' THEN '일정' WHEN 'PERIOD_PLAN' THEN '기간 계획' WHEN 'TIME_PLAN' THEN '시간 계획' WHEN 'WEEKLY_PLAN' THEN '주간 계획' WHEN 'TASK' THEN '작업 보드' ELSE '기록' END ORDER BY f.FOLDER_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM=1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTE_FOLDERS ( FOLDER_ID, PARENT_FOLDER_ID, OWNER_USER_ID, SCOPE_TYPE, WS_ID, PROJ_ID, FOLDER_NAME, SORT_ORDER, REG_DT ) SELECT #{folderId}, NULL, NVL(t.OWNER_USER_ID,#{userId}), CASE WHEN t.SCOPE_TYPE='PERSONAL' THEN 'PRIVATE' WHEN t.SCOPE_TYPE='GROUP' THEN 'WS' ELSE 'PROJ' END, t.WS_ID, t.PROJ_ID, CASE t.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'EVENT' THEN '일정' WHEN 'PERIOD_PLAN' THEN '기간 계획' WHEN 'TIME_PLAN' THEN '시간 계획' WHEN 'WEEKLY_PLAN' THEN '주간 계획' WHEN 'TASK' THEN '작업 보드' ELSE '기록' END, 0, SYSDATE FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS t WHERE t.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND t.TARGET_STATUS IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE')

INSERT INTO NOTE_FOLDERS ( FOLDER_ID, PARENT_FOLDER_ID, OWNER_USER_ID, SCOPE_TYPE, WS_ID, PROJ_ID, FOLDER_NAME, SORT_ORDER, REG_DT ) SELECT #{folderId}, #{parentFolderId}, NVL(t.OWNER_USER_ID,#{userId}), CASE WHEN t.SCOPE_TYPE='PERSONAL' THEN 'PRIVATE' WHEN t.SCOPE_TYPE='GROUP' THEN 'WS' ELSE 'PROJ' END, t.WS_ID, t.PROJ_ID, CASE t.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'EVENT' THEN NVL((SELECT e.TITLE FROM EVENTS e WHERE e.EVENT_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'PERIOD_PLAN' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_PERIOD_PLANS p WHERE p.PERIOD_PLAN_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'TIME_PLAN' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_TIME_PLANS p WHERE p.TIME_PLAN_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'WEEKLY_PLAN' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_WEEKLY_PLANS p WHERE p.WEEKLY_PLAN_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'TASK' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_TASKS p WHERE p.TASK_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') ELSE '임시 기록' END, 0, SYSDATE FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS t WHERE t.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND t.TARGET_STATUS IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTE_FOLDERS f SET f.PARENT_FOLDER_ID=#{parentFolderId}, f.FOLDER_NAME=( SELECT CASE t.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'EVENT' THEN NVL((SELECT e.TITLE FROM EVENTS e WHERE e.EVENT_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'PERIOD_PLAN' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_PERIOD_PLANS p WHERE p.PERIOD_PLAN_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'TIME_PLAN' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_TIME_PLANS p WHERE p.TIME_PLAN_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'WEEKLY_PLAN' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_WEEKLY_PLANS p WHERE p.WEEKLY_PLAN_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') WHEN 'TASK' THEN NVL((SELECT p.TITLE FROM PROJECT_TASKS p WHERE p.TASK_ID=t.TARGET_ID), '제목 없음') ELSE '임시 기록' END FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS t WHERE t.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} ), f.UPD_DT=SYSDATE WHERE f.FOLDER_ID=(SELECT t.NOTE_FOLDER_ID FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS t WHERE t.RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId})

UPDATE CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS SET NOTE_FOLDER_ID=#{noteFolderId}, UPDATED_BY=#{userId}, UPDATED_AT=SYSDATE WHERE RECORD_TARGET_ID=#{recordTargetId} AND NOTE_FOLDER_ID IS NULL AND TARGET_STATUS IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM NOTE_FOLDERS f WHERE f.FOLDER_ID=#{folderId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NOTES n WHERE n.FOLDER_ID=f.FOLDER_ID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS t WHERE t.NOTE_FOLDER_ID=f.FOLDER_ID)
